ev_wh_aridity_slm11_macro.locator: PDF p. 87 (printed p. 90), rainwater harvesting applicability
ev_wh_aridity_slm11_macro.disposition: Keep macrocatchment guidance where runoff events are infrequent. Microcatchments suit more reliable rain. Event frequency supplies no numeric P/PET boundary.
ev_wh_aridity_slm11_macro.source_guidance: Climate: RWH techniques are most relevant in semi-arid and subhumid zones with poorly distributed rains, in particular in cereal–based areas. In more arid regions they are used for tree crops and / or establishing trees for afforestation. Micro-catchments are more suitable for areas with more reliable rainfall, whereas macro-catchments are effective in areas where few runoff events are expected.

ev_wh_aridity_index_kahinda08_3.locator: PDF p. 3, Table 2, XRWH row and model weights on PDF p. 5
ev_wh_aridity_index_kahinda08_3.disposition: Keep all five South African external-catchment ranks and the 0.34 climate weight within this study. Hyper-arid sites receive rank 1. Use rainfall or aridity once. Rank-to-score conversion and shared endpoint assignment remain open.

ev_wh_clay_content_kahinda08_2.locator: PDF p. 3, Table 4, XRWH column and model weights on PDF p. 5
ev_wh_clay_content_kahinda08_2.disposition: Keep all six external-catchment clay classes, the original 2–1 range and the within-study 0.33 texture weight. Interpret clay for the runoff-producing area. Assess receiving soil separately.

ev_wh_soil_permeability_vema19_1.locator: PDF p. 4, Table 2 and section 3.3, and PDF p. 7, watershed permeability
ev_wh_soil_permeability_vema19_1.disposition: Keep the three trapezoidal permeability classes as joint inputs with slope and runoff. Preserve separate surface-storage and recharge outcomes. No independent permeability-to-suitability conversion.
ev_wh_soil_permeability_vema19_1.conditional_example: Low permeability, low slope and high runoff favour check dams and farm ponds. The same combination is unsuitable for percolation tanks.

decision_scope: Four runoff-catchment cards presented together: FAO/WOCAT runoff reliability, Kahinda external aridity and clay tables, and Vema joint permeability inputs.
